method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 35 of 41 breaks heard

lines.latin: Miserére mei Deus,
lines.english: Have mercy on me, O God,

lines.latin: secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
lines.english: according to Thy great mercy.

lines.latin: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum,
lines.english: And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies

lines.latin: dele iniquitátem meam.
lines.english: blot out my iniquity.

lines.latin: Amplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea:
lines.english: Wash me yet more from my iniquity,

lines.latin: et a peccáto meo munda me.
lines.english: and cleanse me from my sin.

lines.latin: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco:
lines.english: For I know my iniquity,

lines.latin: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
lines.english: and my sin is always before me.

lines.latin: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci:
lines.english: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee:

lines.latin: ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
lines.english: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

lines.latin: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum:
lines.english: For behold I was conceived in iniquities:

lines.latin: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
lines.english: and in sins did my mother conceive me.

lines.latin: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti:
lines.english: For behold Thou hast loved truth:

lines.latin: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
lines.english: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

lines.latin: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor:
lines.english: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed:

lines.latin: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
lines.english: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

lines.latin: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam:
lines.english: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness:

lines.latin: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
lines.english: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

lines.latin: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis:
lines.english: Turn away Thy face from my sins,

lines.latin: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
lines.english: and blot out all my iniquities.

lines.latin: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus:
lines.english: Create a clean heart in me, O God:

lines.latin: et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
lines.english: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

lines.latin: Ne projícias me a fácie tua:
lines.english: Cast me not away from Thy face:

lines.latin: et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
lines.english: and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

lines.latin: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui:
lines.english: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation,

lines.latin: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
lines.english: and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

lines.latin: Docébo iníquos vias tuas:
lines.english: I will teach the unjust Thy ways:

lines.latin: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
lines.english: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

lines.latin: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ:
lines.english: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation:

lines.latin: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
lines.english: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

lines.latin: Dómine, lábia mea apéries:
lines.english: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips:

lines.latin: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
lines.english: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

lines.latin: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique:
lines.english: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it:

lines.latin: holocáustis non delectáberis.
lines.english: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

lines.latin: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus:
lines.english: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit:

lines.latin: cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
lines.english: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

lines.latin: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion:
lines.english: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion:

lines.latin: ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
lines.english: that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

lines.latin: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta:
lines.english: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings:

lines.latin: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
lines.english: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

lines.latin: Miserére mei Deus:
lines.english: Have mercy on me, O God:

lines.latin: miserére mei.
lines.english: have mercy on me.
